tools.name: search_vacancies
tools.description: Search job vacancies on hh.ru by keywords, region, professional role, industry, metro, salary, experience, employment form, work format, date range and labels. Returns a compact paginated summary (pass raw:true for full JSON).

text.description: Search query. Supports hh.ru query language (quotes, AND/OR/NOT, field:). e.g. "python AND django"

area.description: Region code (1=Moscow, 2=Saint Petersburg). Use get_areas / suggest_areas to find codes.

professional_role.description: Professional role id. Use get_professional_roles / suggest_professional_roles to find ids.

industry.description: Industry id (employer industry). Use get_industries to find ids.

metro.description: Metro station or line id. Use get_metro to find ids.

employer_id.description: Restrict results to a single employer id.

salary.description: Desired salary amount (sent together with currency).

currency.description: Salary currency (RUR, USD, EUR). Only applied when salary is set; defaults to RUR.

label.description: Vacancy label filter (replaces the deprecated only_with_salary — use with_salary).

employment_form.description: Employment form (modern replacement for the deprecated `employment`).

work_format.description: Work format (modern replacement for schedule=remote etc.).

employment.description: DEPRECATED by hh.ru — prefer employment_form. Still accepted.

schedule.description: DEPRECATED by hh.ru — prefer work_format. Still accepted.

search_field.description: Restrict the text search to a single field.

period.description: Only vacancies published within the last N days (1-30). Mutually exclusive with date_from/date_to.

date_from.description: Published from this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01). Mutually exclusive with period.

date_to.description: Published up to this date (ISO 8601). Mutually exclusive with period.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact summary.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Get full resume details: experience, education, skills, contacts. If the resume came through an отклик, always pass topic_id (+vacancy_id): the unscoped read hits the resume database, consumes a paid view and is the call hh.ru captcha-gates. When HH_REQUIRE_TOPIC is on, unscoped reads require allow_unscoped:true. Requires an EMPLOYER OAuth token + paid resume-database access.

topic_id.description: Negotiation (отклик) topic id the resume came through. Supplying it reads the resume in the context of your own response instead of the resume database.

vacancy_id.description: Vacancy id the negotiation belongs to. Used together with topic_id.

allow_unscoped.description: Confirm a paid resume-database view when topic_id is omitted. Required when HH_REQUIRE_TOPIC is on.

no_cache.description: Skip disk cache and force a fresh read.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact summary.

tools.name: get_resumes
tools.description: Safely fetch up to 50 resumes sequentially through the resume-view budget (default ~1.5s spacing, 20 reads/60s window). Preferred input: items:[{resume_id, topic_id}] + vacancy_id for scoped reads; set require_topic:true to never read the paid database. Legacy resume_ids+topics is validated (typo'd keys fail before any request). Reads without topic_id return status unscoped. Pass out_dir to persist payloads (raw/*.json + manifest.json + negotiations.csv). stop_on_captcha default true. max_wait_ms default 90000 (cap 110000). Requires HH_ACCESS_TOKEN.

topic_id.description: Negotiation (отклик) id for a scoped read

items.description: Preferred input: [{resume_id, topic_id, vacancy_id?}] (1..50). Keeps each resume with its negotiation id so a typo cannot silently turn into a paid unscoped read. Do not combine with resume_ids/topics.

resume_ids.description: Legacy input: resume ids to fetch (1..50). Prefer items.

topics.description: Legacy: map resume_id → topic_id. Every key must be one of resume_ids, otherwise the call fails before any request.

vacancy_id.description: Vacancy id applied with each topic_id

require_topic.description: Never read without topic_id: rows lacking one are returned as skipped with no network call. Recommended true.

out_dir.description: Persist payloads to <out_dir>/raw/<resume_id>__<topic_id>.json plus manifest.json and negotiations.csv. Existing valid files are reused without a network read.

max_wait_ms.description: Stop starting new gated reads after this many ms (hard-capped at 110000; DSH timeout is 120s). At default 1.5s spacing ≈55 resumes/call.

raw.description: Return structured JSON instead of the compact Russian summary.

tools.name: collect_vacancy_resumes
tools.description: Walk a vacancy funnel (collection/sub_collection), fetch each resume with topic_id through the gated budget, write raw JSON + manifest/csv under out_dir (HH_EXPORT_DIR). Bounded by max (default 25) and max_wait_ms; returns an id-based cursor/remaining when truncated (safe when new responses arrive between calls). Prefer this over spawning subagents. Requires HH_ACCESS_TOKEN.

vacancy_id.description: Vacancy id whose responses to collect

max.description: Max resumes to fetch this call (default 25, max 100)

cursor.description: Opaque resume point from a previous truncated call

max_wait_ms.description: Stop starting new gated reads after this many ms (cap 110000)

raw.description: Return structured JSON instead of the compact Russian summary.

tools.description: Vacancy application funnel: per-stage and per-sub-stage counters plus unread (with_updates). Sub-collection ids are inputs for list_applications. Also lists employer_states. Start here before list_applications. Requires HH_ACCESS_TOKEN.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact summary.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applications for a vacancy by collection or sub_collection (id/name), with optional with_updates_only (scans collection pages for has_updates; page/per_page are the filtered stream; capped by HH_MAX_SCAN_PAGES), page/per_page/order_by. raw:true returns one unfiltered upstream page. Defaults collection to response. Requires HH_ACCESS_TOKEN.

collection.description: Collection id or sub-collection id from list_application_collections (e.g. "response", "invited", or "response_107261719"). Defaults to "response" when sub_collection is not set.

sub_collection.description: Sub-stage id ("response_107261719"), bare funnel-stage id ("107261719"), or a name / name substring ("Подходят"), case-insensitive; account-specific — see list_application_collections.

page.description: Page number (0-based). With with_updates_only, pages the filtered match stream (not a single hh.ru API page).

per_page.description: Results per page. With with_updates_only, size of each filtered page (scan uses up to 50 items per upstream request).

order_by.description: Sort order (e.g. created_at, relevance, last_change_time_except_employer_inbox). Use get_preferred_negotiations_order for the vacancy default.

with_updates_only.description: If true, return only items with has_updates by scanning collection pages (capped by HH_MAX_SCAN_PAGES, default 10). page/per_page apply to the filtered stream. raw:true still returns one unfiltered upstream page.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact summary.

tools.name: get_salary_statistics
tools.description: Salary distribution for a role/region. With HH_ACCESS_TOKEN + area_id, tries paid Банк данных зарплат (/salary_statistics/paid/salary_evaluation/{area_id}); on 401/403/404 or without token/area falls back to sampling vacancy salaries (biased). Optional speciality/employee_level/industry/extend_sources for the bank; text maps to position_name.

professional_role_id.description: Professional role ID for vacancy-based fallback. Use get_professional_roles or suggest_professional_roles. Not the same id space as salary-bank `speciality`.

area_id.description: Region code. Required to try the paid salary bank (path param). For vacancies fallback this is a regular /areas id (1=Moscow). Salary-bank areas usually match major regions.

text.description: Keyword / job title. Used as vacancy text filter in fallback, and as `position_name` for the paid bank when set.

speciality.description: Salary-bank speciality id (from /salary_statistics/dictionaries/professional_areas). Improves paid-bank queries.

employee_level.description: Salary-bank employee level id (from /salary_statistics/dictionaries/employee_levels), e.g. specialist.

extend_sources.description: Paid bank only: if true, allow resumes/vacancies when bank sample is thin (extend_sources=true).

sample_pages.description: Vacancy-fallback only: pages of 100 salaried vacancies to sample (1-5).

raw.description: Return the stats object / paid bank JSON instead of the formatted summary.
